text: 【泰国9月通胀率升至2.82% 能源食品价格上涨推高物价】泰国商务部贸易政策与战略办公室6日公布的数据显示，泰国9月消费者价格指数(CPI)同比上涨2.82%，较8月的2.53%进一步上升，但仍处于泰国央行1%至3%的通胀目标区间内。
text_en: [Thailand's September inflation rate rises to 2.82%, with higher energy and food prices pushing up prices] Data released on the 6th by the Trade Policy and Strategy Office of Thailand's Ministry of Commerce showed that Thailand's consumer price index (CPI) rose 2.82% year-on-year in September, further rising from 2.53% in August, but still within the Bank of Thailand's inflation target range of 1% to 3%.
